summary:
Iteration 6 review: Backend + Frontend both green on the P0 Discover feature request. Discover API returns 31 events across 15 cities + 11 categories with all requested enrichment fields (sold_percentage, headline_talent, talent_count, tenant_count, vendor_count, sponsor_slots, sponsor_sold, economic_ripple, is_live, days_to_event, this_week) plus totals{} and highlights{live,this_week,almost_sold_out,top_impact}. Discover page renders network stats strip, 'N event ditemukan' counter, reset button restores full list, all four section carousels (live=2, this_week=6, almost_sold_out=3, top_impact=4) hide when a filter is active, 'Semua event' grid lists all 31 cards, cards show organizer, headline talent, tiket terjual % bar, tenant/vendor/sponsor counts, economic ripple, price and Lihat Event / Simpan (persists in localStorage okkax_saved). Filters (city=Bandung=>3, category=Esports=>3, free=true=>3, q='fashion'=>2) all work. /peta renders 15 city bubbles with 31 events aggregate, 8 metric switches, city detail panel, city ranking bar chart. Public bulk event /events/evt-b-nusantara-sound-fest loads with 3 tiers and Dimas Arka talent; end-to-end checkout+simulate on it succeeds. Workspace Event Graph /app/events/evt-b-nusantara-sound-fest/graph as organizer renders 23 nodes, 22 edges, 12 filter chips, zoom controls, detail panel. /juri persona buttons (5 personas) present, no password leak in body. AI engines endpoint responds. Stripe checkout endpoint returns checkout_url. All 23 backend tests PASS.

HOWEVER a persistent palette regression: the 'Only black + pink + white' constraint is still violated by status/readiness badge colors — emerald green (rgb(52,211,153)) on event-detail Event Readiness chips ('Organizer Verified', 'Venue Confirmed', 'Talent Confirmed', 'Ticketing Active', 'Refund Policy Available', 'Accessibility Information Available') and Talent 'Confirmed' pill; green 'Berfungsi' badges on /juri; and Confirmed(green)/Pending(amber)/At-Risk(orange)/Completed(blue) status chips + node dots inside the Workspace Event Graph. The Landing page dots from iter5 are now fixed.

issues: 'Event Readiness' badges use emerald-400 green (rgb(52,211,153)) — 6 badges. Talent 'Confirmed' pill also emerald. Violates black/pink/white palette.
Status legend and per-row 'Berfungsi' badges render green (~32 emerald classes in DOM). Violates palette.

Status chips (Confirmed=green, Pending=amber, At Risk=orange, Completed=blue) and matching node-status dots inside the graph are not palette-compliant. Suggest mapping status -> pink/white/zinc tokens (Confirmed=white, Pending=pink-300, At Risk=pink-600, Completed=zinc-400) similar to the fix already applied to Landing.jsx.

action_items: Replace emerald/green status color usage in Event Readiness badges on PublicEvent.jsx with palette tokens.
Replace green 'Berfungsi' badges on /juri (Juri.jsx) with palette-compliant tokens.
Replace status color map (Confirmed/Pending/At Risk/Completed) used by workspace Event Graph nodes and chips with palette-only tokens — same treatment already applied to Landing DOT map.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1817 lines — still well over 700-line guideline; the enriched /discover/events handler now does O(events * (tiers+booths+vendors+pkgs+budget)) DB reads per request. With 31 events this is ~150 round-trips per call; acceptable at demo scale but should be batched (aggregation pipeline) before adding more events.

Discover.jsx uses `Rp100.60 M` for economic activity via `compact()` — the M suffix is ambiguous (Million vs Milyar). Consider explicit 'Rp100,6 M' with Indonesian 'M' = Milyar (10^9) or spell out 'Miliar'.

PublicEvent readiness color map and BlueprintGraph node color map both hard-code #10b981/#f59e0b/#ef4444 tones — extract to a shared /theme/status.ts token file so future palette audits touch a single place.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all functional flows pass; palette regression on 3 pages)

seed_data_creation: Two sandbox orders created on evt-b-nusantara-sound-fest during checkout tests (TEST_Iter6 Buyer / TEST_Iter6 Stripe). No /api/demo/reset invoked, per agent-to-agent note.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py -v -n0` — all 23 pass. Discover payload key is `items` (not `events`); category filter maps to Mongo field `event_type` (not `category` on the event doc). Login route is `/login` (not `/signin`). Workspace Event Graph is a subroute: `/app/events/{event_id}/graph`. Emergent-managed auth: use POST /api/auth/login and set localStorage['okkax_token']=<token> to bypass UI form. Remaining palette regressions all reduce to one root cause: a shared status color palette (Confirmed=emerald, Pending=amber, At Risk=orange, Completed=blue) still used by (a) PublicEvent readiness badges, (b) Juri page 'Berfungsi' badge, (c) BlueprintGraph node/chip status colors. Landing.jsx DOT map was already fixed.
